proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Class 'approved as noted'. Keep the literal verbatim. Record that resubmission is required in a note (or a resubmission_required flag if the schema adds one). The option is printed apart from 'Revise / Resubmit' and 'Rejected / Resubmit', and the reviewer's own comment on F001/F031 reads 'approved in principle ... incorporate with the following comments & resubmit': an approval with conditions, not a refusal. The same rule should apply to 'Code B+Resubmit' / 'B+R' (F030, not in this batch) when the page's legend defines B as approved with comments.

The issuer's unhighlighted 'FOR INFORMATION ONLY' box is not a reviewing-party decision and does not lower the class. The literal is the stamp's own decision text only. A separate mark of unestablished authorship (here the yellow 'APPROVED' box) must not be joined into the literal; it is noted as corroboration.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (c) duplicate content beyond byte-identical files (F031 vs F001)
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: When the in-scope pages of two staged files that carry a field are render-identical (an empty pixel difference) and carry the same values, the pair counts once in that field's population; the lower id carries the count. Both stay labelled. Pages added by one file (the F031 comments resolution sheet) do not make it independent unless they carry a different identity, revision or decision. Near-duplicate exports (F046/F059, not in this batch) should be compared on the field values, not on bytes.
